generation.description: A mismatch (the owning Run has since been cancelled/superseded) is treated as an ownership miss, same as today's owner/lease guard.

description:
Heartbeat body: the generation the caller claimed this item under. The
    endpoint binds this parameter as nullable — a pre-WS4/WS5 Translator that sends
    no body at all still gets the documented 409 `work-item.not-owner` instead
    of a 400 (see `WorkerEndpoints.HeartbeatAsync`).
